headline: Paid Social & Digital Media | Campaign Execution | Attribution
headline_rationale: LTK seeks hands-on Meta/TikTok delivery, budgets, workflow coordination and performance measurement. Master supports paid social channel management and campaign analytics; creator boosting specialization and influencer-contract results are not invented.
summary: Digital media practitioner with hands-on experience across Meta, Instagram, TikTok, Google and Microsoft campaigns. Managed approximately $400,000 in monthly advertising budget, working with creative and web partners on campaign priorities and conversion performance. Combines audience research, funnel testing and attribution models with clear KPI dashboards and automated reporting. Agency consulting experience adds practical budget allocation, account organization and recommendations that keep campaign execution connected to client goals and measurable results.
factual_review: Read exact LTK contractor posting, dates and paid social requirements. Supported E030/E044/E003/E006/E082/E038/E009/E076/E081. Do not claim specific creator whitelisting/boosting ownership, celebrity work, beauty expertise or CTR benchmarks absent source.
tools_rationale: Source-supported paid media, commerce and reporting tools for campaign implementation and attribution.
